items.source: Connection package providing low-level abstractions for interacting with the various Redis 'drivers'/libraries.
items.translation: 提供低级抽象的连接器包，用于与各种 Redis“驱动程序”/库进行交互。

items.source: Trimming strategy that evicts entries as long as the stream's length exceeds the specified threshold.
items.translation: 一种修剪策略，只要流长度超过指定阈值就驱逐条目。

items.source: Trimming strategy that evicts entries with IDs lower than the specified threshold.
items.translation: 一种修剪策略，用于驱逐 ID 低于指定阈值的条目。
RedisStreamCommands.TrimStrategy 在 org.springframework.data.redis.connection 中的用途
